data.body:
[P3] Accumulate operation drops across both truncation passes

`exportRecord` has already truncated this record against `render`. When many distinct operations force whole-operation drops in both passes, `Truncation` initializes its counter to zero and overwrites the incoming `droppedOperations`. If the first pass drops 10 operations and this pass drops 3, the emitted record reports only 3, understating missing telemetry. Perform envelope-aware truncation once, or accumulate the incoming drop count during the second pass. Add a regression that forces whole-operation removal in both passes; the new tests explicitly keep the first pass unchanged.
